old_contracts.goal: Represent optional dependencies and forwarding without a second choices grammar.
steps: Define stable dependency declaration IDs and local feature references under the permanent PROP-003 contract.
Implement effects for dependency activation, strong/weak target-feature requests, exported subskills and declared config values.
Keep source/version/link/visibility metadata once on dependency declarations; option aliases remain package-local.
acceptance: Normalized algebra has no duplicated choices.requires dependency engine.
Legacy syntax lowers through one typed representation.

old_contracts.goal: Make semantic choices explicit while retaining environment and target roles.
steps: Consume accepted M-14 resolution-domain/target/dependency-role carriers instead of inventing a global package instance.
Define four cardinalities, positive same-package acyclic guards, explicit defaults and consumer requested selections.
Distinguish omission, explicit empty selection, dormant branch intent and exact shared-instance conflict; keep backend-native version identities outside Vibe SemVer conversion.
acceptance: Generated requests retain owner edge/domain/target and choice provenance.
Defaults are explicit consumer policy inputs, never solver preferences.

old_contracts.goal: Prevent mutable same-version metadata and repeated discovery from changing a solve.
steps: Bind candidate manifests to exact source/content/definition identity rather than version alone.
Create one immutable catalog view for a transaction and cache candidate capabilities within it.
Make missing/corrupt catalog data distinct from a candidate lacking a requested option.
acceptance: Catalog identity is reproducible and inspected through ETO.
Source corruption and candidate incompatibility have different outcomes.

old_contracts.goal: Scope feature and choice implications to the candidate that introduced them.
steps: Attach activation implications and induced requirements to selected candidate literals or an equivalent complete encoding.
Preserve each incoming consumer request/constraint through candidate rejection.
Bind default-based selections to shown exact definitions; changed semantic default requires rediscovery, never automatic backtracking selection.
acceptance: Counterexample fixtures compare selected graph and all derived activation effects.
Conflict evidence retains the consumer and candidate reasons.

old_contracts.goal: Prevent visibility retry and metadata paths from losing constraints or selected edges.
steps: Thread the same immutable request/catalog through solve, manifest_of, solve_masked and conditional/visibility routes.
Retain all root constraints and actual capability/OR-provider choices in the final graph.
Expose backend capability refusal without fallback; keep incomplete conditional combinations explicitly unsupported.
acceptance: Route parity fixtures produce identical selected graph or equivalent typed conflicts.
Every graph edge has a selected declaration/provider provenance.

recommendation.authoring: optional:boolean on existing inline requires.packages entry
recommendation.default: false / mandatory, including every existing string/inline entry
recommendation.explicit_false: same mandatory semantics; preserve authored presence in metadata roundtrip
recommendation.normalized_key: actual declaring instance/candidate plus existing canonical group/name declaration key
recommendation.metadata: source/version/kind/link/access/friend/exclude/child original input stored once on declaration; effects refer to its ID
recommendation.active_set: mandatory union selected dependency activations union selected strong-forward targets, plus only proven activation in same owner instance
recommendation.weak_rule: does not activate; contributes only when same owner declaration is active; unrelated installed/shared target does not count
recommendation.no_implicit: No auto feature/alias/default, no effect-implied optionality, no client-created physical instance
recommendation.compatibility: new reader preserves old source; old strict reader may reject new field; no universal old-reader promise

prototype_limits.finding: optional set is caller input; old authored wire has no optional field
ordinary legacy adapter seeds every requires dependency as mandatory
weak requests filter through this expansion active declaration set
configured solver refuses cross-package TargetFeature effects
configured fixed-consumer route refuses nonregistry dependency declarations

root_decisions.recommendation: Approve existing inline optional bool, no second dependency table

root_decisions.topic: Workspace owner self-configuration and direct explicit-root install
root_decisions.recommendation: Use actual incoming intent for consumed package; unsupported/needs-input when no actual owning activation context; do not clear optional flag or fabricate consent
eager local declaration checks; target-candidate/public-feature checks when consumed; avoid requiring inactive source payload merely to install required graph; root must confirm discovery boundary
